description: This source file defines the `RemotePortTunnel` class used for establishing and managing SSH port forwarding tunnels in remote mode. It includes methods for creating, terminating, and monitoring SSH tunnels, handling port availability checks, and parsing configuration for remote port overrides. The class interacts with system networking APIs and external configurations to facilitate secure remote connectivity.

classes.name: RemotePortTunnel
classes.description: A class that manages SSH tunneling for remote port forwarding, including creating, monitoring, and terminating SSH processes, as well as port availability checks and configuration-based overrides.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Establishes a new SSH port forwarding tunnel asynchronously with specified remote port, local port preferences, and override options.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the SSH process and cleans up resources associated with the tunnel.

methods.name: resolveRemotePortOverride
methods.description: Determines if a remote port override should be applied based on configuration and target host details.

methods.name: findPort
methods.description: Finds an available local port, preferring a specified port if it's free or selecting a random free port.

methods.name: portIsFree
methods.description: Checks if a particular port is available for use on localhost.
